description: Long-context retrieval shape: a real-text instruction, a large synthetic document body and a short question. Agent i targets the i-th PRD section 18 depth (4K/32K/128K/256K); the synthetic body is sized so body + instruction + question stays below the depth with room for 128 generated tokens. Token ids are deterministic from the seed (SplitMix64, see include/halo/profiling/workload.h) and are NOT natural text: use for throughput and memory, never for quality.
provenance: Authored for HALO by WS-J (2026-09). Instruction and question text are original; document bodies are synthetic_tokens segments generated from the listed seeds. Frozen.

preamble.text: You answer questions about the document the user provides. Quote the relevant passage before answering.

turns.text: Summarize the section that discusses error handling, in three sentences.
